game_title: Flowchart Lab · Count up to n
game_concept: A card battler set in Mt. Pyre – Fire Shrine, an ancient fire shrine: the ash ranger must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Mixed Type Oracle: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before cinder bats spring the trap.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Fire Shrine: an ancient fire shrine
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Read n. Print the whole numbers from 1 through n. If n is zero, print nothing. Test dataset 10: {'n': 0}; {'n': 15}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Mixed Type Oracle' (Week 2 slot 15), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Fire Shrine'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Chain 12 consecutive correct decisions about predictions to power up the ash ranger and open the obsidian gate.
source_lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
source_game_title: Mixed Type Oracle – Fire Shrine Streak
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
